title: [Main] - Bug 659462: [Expense Agent]  Add configurable rounding precision for partial-day per diem
summary: The Expense Agent now supports configurable rounding precision for partial-day per diem calculations, allowing administrators to set how fractional daily amounts are rounded.
key_points: New field added to Expense Agent Setup to control rounding precision
Partial-day per diem settings page now includes rounding configuration
Per diem calculation logic updated to apply the configured rounding
Setup wizard displays the new rounding precision option
Test coverage added for rounding behavior
